title: Financial Foundations (November 2026 series)
description: A Bookkeeping Cooperative's most popular public workshop: four weekly 2-hour Zoom sessions covering essential financial terms and the four core financial reports — budget, cash flow, profit & loss, and balance sheet — as tools for a group's goals and values. Beginner-friendly and participatory, with closed captioning; ASL, CART, or advance slides on request at least two weeks before the first session. One ticket covers the full series, sliding scale $150-$2,000. Not recorded; slides and resources are shared with attendees.

recurrence.schedule: Four Mondays — November 2, 9, 16, and 23, 2026 — 1-3pm ET (10am-12pm PT), on Zoom.
